method: Human visual inventory of every original PDF page rendered by Poppler, corroborated against raw source-PDF text and official publisher article pages. No application parser output or detected-resource list was read for this ground truth. Panel groupings and multi-page continuations are counted as one printed logical object.
page_index_convention: Zero-based PDF physical page index, not citation/reference number.

papers.scope: Complete 8-page main article, including supporting-information descriptions on pages 7-8. Separate supporting files are excluded because their visual objects are not embedded in this PDF.

objects.bbox_precision: Approximate independent visual bounding box, rounded to PDF points; includes whole figure/table body and panel labels, excludes external caption and footnotes; approximately 2 PDF-point tolerance.

sample_cells.expected_text: Identify the report as a systematic review.
Describe any sensitivity analyses conducted to assess robustness of the synthesised results.
Cite each included study and present its characteristics.

sample_cells.row_label: Risk of bias in studies / item 18
sample_cells.expected_text: Present assessments of risk of bias for each included study.
Present results of all sensitivity analyses conducted to assess the robustness of the synthesised results.
Indicate where the review protocol can be accessed, or state that a protocol was not prepared.
Declare any competing interests of review authors.

objects.sample_cell_indexing: Zero-based left-to-right column across 4 columns. Row identified by printed topic and item number, because multi-row section headers/merged topic cells make a flat extracted row index ambiguous. Compare whitespace-normalized text; the final blank is intentional.
